name: Third places
blurb: Somewhere that is not work and not home, where nobody asks you to leave.

places.name: Seattle Central Library
places.note: Rem Koolhaas built it. Take the escalator to the Books Spiral, look up, and stay all afternoon. Free.
places.address: The Seattle Public Library - Central Library, 1000, 4th Avenue, Central Business District, First Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98104, United States

places.name: Elliott Bay Book Company
places.note: Capitol Hill. Wooden floors, a cafe at the back, and no one will hurry you.
places.address: Elliott Bay Book Company, 1521, 10th Avenue, Madison Valley, First Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98122, United States

places.name: Volunteer Park
places.note: The Conservatory, the water tower, the art museum and a lot of grass. Capitol Hill's front garden.
places.address: Volunteer Park, 1247, Capitol Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98112, United States

places.name: Cal Anderson Park
places.note: The one everyone ends up at. Shade, a reflecting pool, and a permanent low-grade party in summer.
places.address: Cal Anderson Park, 1635, Madison Valley, Capitol Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98122, United States

places.name: Optimism Brewing Company
places.note: A hall the size of an aircraft hangar with long communal tables. Nobody minds if you nurse one drink.
places.address: 1158, Broadway, Madison Valley, First Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98122, United States

places.name: Ballard Farmers Market
places.note: Sundays, year round, rain included. The most reliable way to spend a morning around other people.
places.address: 5345, Ballard Avenue Northwest, Ballard, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98107, United States

places.name: Waterfall Garden Park
places.note: A hidden courtyard in Pioneer Square with a 22-foot waterfall. Twenty seconds off the street and silent.
places.address: Waterfall Garden, First Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, United States

places.name: Hugo House
places.note: A writing centre with a cafe and a reading calendar. Somewhere to go alone on purpose.
places.address: Hugo House, 1634, 11th Avenue, Madison Valley, Capitol Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98122, United States
